title: Chapter 266 Cerberus Cerberus Breeding Base
content:
Chapter 266 Cerberus Cerberus Breeding Base

Just when Wang Shuo placed the energy crystal on the ground.

The dog tag on Dahuang's neck reacted.

Emits a faint gray light.

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank and he observed carefully.

After looking at it for a while, the dog tag seemed to be swallowing more energy crystals.

Wang Shuo didn't rush to invest more energy crystals just in case.

"Agui, do you know what this is?"

"Lord, according to my observation, this should be a prop that can open a different space, similar to a portal."

Wang Shuo was thoughtful.

He called Gong Zheng and Gude over.

Afterwards, Wang Shuo began to pile energy crystals near the dog tags.

The dog tag began to absorb energy, slowly at first, and soon it was like a bottomless pit, constantly swallowing it.

Wang Shuo was shocked. He had invested 80,000 energy crystals so far.

After a while, the absorption speed began to slow down, and finally 150,000 energy crystals were spent.

The dog tag finally stopped absorbing energy.

However, it sucked in the three dogs and Wang Shuo around them.

Wang Shuo and others fell from high altitude.

He was beaten to pieces.

[You have entered the hell three-headed dog breeding base]

Wang Shuo heard the system prompt and knew that he had entered another dungeon.

Cerberus three-headed dog?

When I hear the name, it sounds so fierce!

What comes into view is a dilapidated breeding base.

Many kennels and cages were built inside, but there was no dog inside.

There were lots of dried dog droppings scattered on the ground.

The cage had suffered varying degrees of damage, and the iron cage was in decay.

It seems that this place has been abandoned for a long time.

If this was the place where the cook Ilham of Black Dragon City kept his dogs, it would have been here for thousands of years.

The breeding base covers a large area, and there is a large dense forest outside.

"Woof."

Dahuang barked, and the dog's hair stood on end.

Suddenly, dogs barked one after another in the jungle.

There are other dogs here.

Wang Shuo was alert. The sound of dogs barking came from far away, approaching quickly.

"alert."

Judging from the sound, there must be a lot of dogs.

Soon, countless vicious dogs surrounded Wang Shuo and others.

One of them was particularly huge, comparable to an adult bull.

The whole body is covered with shiny black dog hair, and the neck is covered with gray and white stripes.

The weirdest thing is that it has three heads, one white, one black, and one gray.

On the huge head, there are sharp fangs and fierce eyes.

The other vicious dogs also have three heads and bodies ranging from big to small.

Wang Shuo checked the attributes.

[Three-Headed Dog of Hell (Golden Boss)]

[Level: Level 40]

[Attack power: 1000]

[Defense: 600]

[Health value: 8000]

[Skills: corrosive poison, burning flames, healing energy. 】

Wang Shuo thought about it carefully, and if there was only this one boss, the three of them could fight it out.

"Prepare to fight."

Gong Zheng took the lead, jumping in front of the boss and activating the taunting skill.

Wang Shuo followed closely behind, his spear shot out like a dragon.

Goode took out his sunset bow and aimed at the dog's head.

Gude himself was level 45. After equipping him with the Sunset Bow, Wang Shuo also gave him a set of gold-level leather armor. His combat effectiveness was even better than before.

The three of them faced the three-headed hell dog with a violent output.

Simply, the other dogs around him didn't swarm him.

This gave Wang Shuo and the others a chance to besiege the boss.
